paragraphs.text: Phyrexian hybrid mana is — as the name implies — hybrid mana and Phyrexian mana at the same time. It can be paid in three different ways, by paying either one of the two colors or 2 life . It was introduced in Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty on Tamiyo, Compleated Sage .

Compleation is the process by which one becomes Phyrexian . So far, all spells that have Phyrexian hybrid mana are planeswalkers that also have the compleated keyword ability . While Phyrexian mana has been known as difficult to balance, its tie with compleated solves several of its problems. Its link to a planeswalker's starting loyalty decreases the effectiveness of that planeswalker in proportion to the decreased mana cost .

Tamiyo, Compleated Sage debuted hybrid Phyrexian mana along with the compleated keyword ability . Paying life allows you cast Tamiyo perhaps a turn sooner, but she'll enter with two fewer loyalty counters . It was next used with Ajani, Sleeper Agent ( Dominaria United ) before a further two cards were added in Phyrexia: All Will Be One ( Lukka, Bound to Ruin and Nahiri, the Unforgiving ). At the conclusion of the Phyrexian Arc , only four of the ten color pairs had Phyrexian hybrid mana—two allied color pairs ( , ) and two enemy color pairs ( , ).
The other six symbols are described in the comprehensive rules, but were never printed on a card: , , , , & .
With New Phyrexia currently phased out of the Multiverse, new cards featuring Phyrexian hybrid mana are unlikely to appear outside of a supplemental set .
